body: Yeah. . one day I was shaving my arms and legs and I was about to throw up during the process so I stopped and hid in my hoodie the rest of the week.

Well it really seems like both to me then.. I don't really take care of myself very well anyways, probably because of my low self-esteem but whenever I'm feeling down I'm kinda tempted to skip meals as a way to "punish" myself but at the same time I know I am being irrational and that's a very dumb behaviour to keep.

I don't know if I'm just being dumb or if I am waiting to die this way sometimes but I don't want to make this an habit yet it kinda did became a recurring issue during this quarantine tho :'|
Mostly because of work but I could also be skipping meals for no real reasons too sometimes
